import sys
import re

def document_analyser(doc):
    # Words outside parentheses: remove all parenthesized parts
    outside = re.sub(r'\([^)]*\)', '', doc)
    word_pattern = r'[^\W\d_]+'  # matches Unicode letters
    words_outside = re.findall(word_pattern, outside)
    longest = max((len(w) for w in words_outside), default=0)

    # Words inside parentheses: extract each parenthesized part
    words_inside = 0
    for match in re.finditer(r'\(([^)]*)\)', doc):
        inside = match.group(1)
        words_inside += len(re.findall(word_pattern, inside))

    return longest, words_inside

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])  # not used
    s = data[1]
    longest, words_inside = document_analyser(s)
    print(f"{longest} {words_inside}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
